effect: The surface barrier is restored, while deeper repair and strengthening continue; the patch may retain a scar.
reaction: The ending ties the cellular work back to the same hand that held the glass, though the remaining repair makes the outcome less abrupt.

mostWorthwhile.text: Processing and exporting the collagen was most worthwhile because it connected protein building inside cells to the supporting fibers around them.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the finished fibers to the body felt fairly predictable after the preceding construction, though it made their role at the scrape clear.

surprise.text: I was interested that nearby signals influence skin cells to move and multiply without a separate command from the brain.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although the compatible-partner menu guided the choices and the last two combinations were the only offered actions.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter if it explored another concrete body process; the connection between cell work and tissue repair held my interest, although several steps became predictable.
